n6e41fc571a.headline: PwC Azerbaijan and Baku Stock Exchange sign MoU to strengthen capital markets
n6e41fc571a.summary: PwC Azerbaijan and the Baku Stock Exchange signed a memorandum of understanding to accelerate development of the country's capital markets and financial sector.
n6e41fc571a.why: The Baku Stock Exchange is Azerbaijan's main securities exchange, and deeper capital markets support financing and investor access.

nec2790581e.headline: Borica: Bank payment instant transfers in Bulgaria rose 69% in 2025 y/y
nec2790581e.summary: Instant bank payment transfers in Bulgaria rose 69% year on year in 2025 to 38.3 million, according to Borica, which runs the national payment infrastructure.
nec2790581e.why: Borica operates Bulgaria's national payment infrastructure, so transfer volumes indicate digital payment adoption in the country.

n1254366df7.headline: Spire Healthcare draws buyout interest, Bridgepoint and Triton emerge as early bidders
n1254366df7.summary: Spire Healthcare confirmed that buyout firms Bridgepoint and Triton have entered early-stage talks with the company as its strategic review gathers pace.
n1254366df7.why: Spire Healthcare is a UK private hospital operator. Takeover talks by private equity firms can reprice a listed company's shares and signal how investors value UK healthcare assets.

nfb7ebaf580.headline: Ryanair Q3 profits dented by Italian fine; fare growth, traffic outlook lifted
nfb7ebaf580.summary: Ryanair reported lower third-quarter profits, hit by an Italian fine, but lifted its FY26 fare growth and traffic outlook, citing strong demand.
nfb7ebaf580.why: Ryanair is Europe's largest low-cost airline by passengers. Its fare and traffic guidance is watched as a read on European air travel demand and pricing.

n31be51fdbc.headline: Emirates expands its Chauffeur-Drive service at two Japanese airports
n31be51fdbc.summary: The Djibouti Ports and Free Zones Authority has prohibited newly licensed Ethiopian Multimodal Transport Operators from operating through the Port of Djibouti, exposing structural logistics risks for Ethiopia.
n31be51fdbc.why: Djibouti port handles most of Ethiopia's seaborne trade, so access rules there directly affect Ethiopian importers, exporters and logistics firms.

n56e7e18471.headline: Azerbaijan-Israel business forum sees new MoU to deepen private sector cooperation
n56e7e18471.summary: The National Confederation of Entrepreneurs of Azerbaijan and the Manufacturers Association of Israel are set to sign a memorandum of understanding. The signing takes place at the Azerbaijan-Israel Business Forum.
n56e7e18471.why: Business associations' memoranda set frameworks for private sector cooperation between countries. Their practical trade and investment effects depend on follow-up deals.

n80124fb7d4.headline: Azerbaijan’s oil exports to Greece show shifting dynamics amid broader trade slowdown
n80124fb7d4.summary: Azerbaijan exported 702.4 thousand tons of oil and oil products to Greece in 2025, worth $367.7 million, according to State Customs Committee data. Value rose sharply on 2024.
n80124fb7d4.why: Azerbaijan is an oil exporter whose crude and product shipments are a key part of its state revenue and trade balance.

nc6648024c3.headline: FDH Bank plc declares K50 billion second interim dividend for 2025 | Nyasa Times
nc6648024c3.summary: FDH Bank Plc declared a second interim dividend of K50.032 billion, equivalent to K7.25 per share, following a board resolution. The payout covers its 2025 financial year.
nc6648024c3.why: Interim dividends are cash payments a company makes to shareholders before its annual results, and bank payouts reflect capital and profitability.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

n77d1b9e1fd.headline: ​JBS N.V. (JBS) to Double Production in Jeddah
n77d1b9e1fd.summary: JBS is set to double production at its chicken processing plant in Jeddah by the end of 2026, Reuters reported. The company built the plant last year in Saudi Arabia.
n77d1b9e1fd.why: JBS is a major global meat processor, and its expansion in Saudi Arabia reflects demand for food supply in the Gulf region.

n915bd40d81.headline: Gen Z in Pakistan struggles with inflation, unemployment and growing discontent: Report
n915bd40d81.summary: A report says nearly 60 per cent of Pakistan's population is under 30 and the country faces a critical test over inflation and unemployment. Youth discontent is growing, according to the report.
n915bd40d81.why: Inflation and unemployment shape consumer demand, fiscal stability and political risk in emerging markets such as Pakistan.

nf6c7679b29.headline: Gold hits record high as investors seek safety
nf6c7679b29.summary: Gold reached a record high and closed in on $5,000 an ounce as investors sought safe-haven assets amid geopolitical tensions. The source article is dated January 22, 2026.
nf6c7679b29.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors often buy during geopolitical stress or when confidence in currencies weakens. It is priced mainly on COMEX in New York.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The article reports gold hitting a record high and closing near $5,000 an ounce.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nf6c7679b29.why_moved: Gold closed near $5,000 an ounce as investors sought safety amid geopolitical tensions, according to the source description.

n2ad5676d28.headline: Demetra Holdings acquires more of its own shares
n2ad5676d28.summary: Demetra Holdings announced another own shares buyback on Monday, carried out under the authorisation granted by its annual general meeting and Cyprus Stock Exchange rules.
n2ad5676d28.why: Share buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding and are a common way for listed companies to return capital to shareholders.

ne2e5f3f49c.headline: EU Secondary Aluminium Prices Firm Amid Scrap Shortages
ne2e5f3f49c.summary: EU secondary aluminium prices are firming as scrap shortages create supply challenges. The report highlights the factors driving the price moves.
ne2e5f3f49c.why: Aluminium is a widely used industrial metal, and scrap-based secondary supply is an important source of it. Scrap availability affects producer costs and metal prices.

n24b5cb4298.headline: Budget 2026: Nasscom pushes for startup-friendly tax policies, cloud regulation clarity
n24b5cb4298.summary: Ahead of the Union Budget 2026, the IT industry body Nasscom urged the government to address tax concerns for startups and technology firms. It also called for clarity on cloud regulation.
n24b5cb4298.why: India's annual budget sets tax and regulatory policy that affects its large technology services sector and startup ecosystem.

n7713cd200c.headline: PVR INOX to sell 4700BC to Marico at whopping Rs 226.8 cr all-cash deal
n7713cd200c.summary: PVR INOX will divest its premium snacking business under the 4700BC brand to Marico in an all-cash transaction valued at Rs 226.8 crore.
n7713cd200c.why: PVR INOX is India's largest multiplex cinema operator, and Marico is a consumer goods company, so this is a portfolio exit and acquisition in Indian consumer markets.

n91307ca2f9.headline: Eco-Shop's net profit rose by 15.5% to RM61.89mil 2Q26
n91307ca2f9.summary: Eco-Shop Marketing Bhd's net profit rose to RM61.89 million in the quarter ended Nov 30, 2025, from RM53.60 million a year earlier, up 15.5%.
n91307ca2f9.why: Eco-Shop Marketing is a Malaysian retail-focused company listed in Kuala Lumpur, and its quarterly results indicate its profitability trend.

nb03b21f282.headline: Grower establishes Tairāwhiti's largest rooftop solar installation for energy resilience
nb03b21f282.summary: A grower has established the largest rooftop solar installation in Tairāwhiti at Waerenga-a-Hika. The project follows 18 months of planning, according to the report.
nb03b21f282.why: Rooftop solar reduces a farm's reliance on grid electricity, lowering operating costs and improving energy resilience for agricultural businesses.

n1fabafdadd.headline: Gold blasts past $US5000 to record on safe-haven rush
n1fabafdadd.summary: Gold hit a new high above $5,000 an ounce, a record, after rising 64% in 2025. Sustained safe-haven demand has supported the metal.
n1fabafdadd.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price reflects investor demand during periods of economic and geopolitical uncertainty.
n1fabafdadd.why_moved: Sustained safe-haven demand pushed gold past $5,000 to a record, according to the report.

nb813c55118.headline: Pakistan survives on bailouts and strategic support, reforms still elusive: Report
nb813c55118.summary: A report says Pakistan's economy continues to depend on external support rather than real reform. Policymakers still rely on foreign borrowing and strategic alliances.
nb813c55118.why: Pakistan's reliance on external financing affects its sovereign creditworthiness and its standing with lenders such as the IMF.

n7f96e95e36.headline: PDD Holdings (PDD) Facing Regulatory Challenges, Here’s What You Need To Know
n7f96e95e36.summary: Reuters reported that PDD Holdings was fined 100,000 yuan, about $14,359, by the Shanghai district taxation bureau. The penalty was for failing to submit tax information as required.
n7f96e95e36.why: PDD Holdings operates the Pinduoduo and Temu e-commerce platforms, and regulatory and tax actions in China can affect its compliance costs and reputation.

na5f630b47b.headline: Cheap Chinese imports flood Indonesia, threatening MSMEs and local manufacturing
na5f630b47b.summary: Indonesia's micro, small and medium enterprises face growing pressure as cheap Chinese imports flood domestic markets. A report raised concerns about long-term industrial health.
na5f630b47b.why: Import competition from lower-cost producers can hurt local manufacturers and shape trade policy and industrial investment decisions.

n2ee88adbe1.headline: Bangladesh panel says Adani power deal overpriced, flags procedural flaws
n2ee88adbe1.summary: A Bangladesh panel said an Adani Power coal-fired plant deal is overpriced and flagged procedural flaws. The plant exports electricity and passes on Indian corporate taxes to Bangladesh.
n2ee88adbe1.why: Adani Power is the listed power generation arm of India's Adani Group, and its export contracts carry regulatory and payment risk.

nd86ad71c60.headline: As gold smashes $5k, speculation about $6k mounts
nd86ad71c60.summary: Gold has risen above $5,000 for the first time, and deVere Group CEO Nigel Green says it could reach $6,000 by year-end. He links the rise to shifting perceptions of political risk and debt.
nd86ad71c60.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that investors often hold during periods of political and financial uncertainty. deVere Group is a global financial advisory firm.

n94fe650d22.headline: Historic surge: PSX crosses 191,000 points milestone
n94fe650d22.summary: The KSE-100 index jumped over 1,800 points to an all-time high of 191,032 on Monday. Investors were positive ahead of the State Bank of Pakistan's monetary policy announcement.
n94fe650d22.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is Pakistan's main equity market, and its KSE-100 index tracks the largest listed companies. Interest-rate expectations are a key driver of equity valuations.
n94fe650d22.why_moved: Investors were optimistic about a possible State Bank of Pakistan rate cut ahead of its monetary policy announcement.

nde9eb099ba.headline: Microsoft rolls out Maia 200 AI chips; launch note also has 'message' for Google and Amazon
nde9eb099ba.summary: Microsoft is rolling out Maia 200, its second-generation AI chip. The company positions it as a potential alternative in AI computing.
nde9eb099ba.why: Microsoft is a major cloud and AI provider, and custom AI chips reduce its reliance on third-party suppliers such as Nvidia.

ne1eb177881.headline: EU flags non-tariff barriers in Bangladesh: Commerce secretary
ne1eb177881.summary: Bangladesh's commerce secretary said the EU highlighted 15 issues relating to customs processes and daily operations as non-tariff barriers.
ne1eb177881.why: The EU is one of Bangladesh's largest export markets, mainly for garments. Non-tariff barriers can slow trade flows even when tariffs are low.

n093b619685.headline: Chunghwa Telecom unveils AI, infrastructure strategy
n093b619685.summary: Taiwanese telco Chunghwa Telecom plans to increase investment by NT$4 billion, focused on AI and building distributed AI datacentre infrastructure.
n093b619685.why: Chunghwa Telecom is Taiwan's largest telecom operator. Investment in AI infrastructure reflects broader demand for data centre capacity.

n6376714fd5.headline: SA’s economic recovery gains momentum, Ramaphosa says
n6376714fd5.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa announced that the country's economy has recorded four consecutive quarters of growth, indicating a strengthening recovery.
n6376714fd5.why: South Africa is the continent's largest economy; sustained growth signals improving business conditions and investor confidence in the region.

nd8c943b220.headline: Bank of Cyprus secures international award for high-standard payment systems
nd8c943b220.summary: Bank of Cyprus received the 'STP AWARD 2025' from The Bank of New York for excellence in fund transfer procedures via the SWIFT system for the fourth consecutive year.
nd8c943b220.why: Recognition for payment system quality enhances the bank's reputation and operational efficiency, important for investor confidence and financial sector stability in Cyprus.
